description: Anonymous visitors see 'Manage your plan' on the Developer and Team cards; both link to /console/billing without the chosen plan, so clicking sends a signed-out visitor to sign-in with no plan context.
expected: Label like 'Choose Developer' / 'Sign in to upgrade' and plan carried through sign-in.
actual: Both buttons go to /console/billing and, signed out, to Clerk sign-in.
suggested_fix: Use signed-out labels ('Start with Developer') and pass ?plan=developer through sign-up.

description: Developer card is highlighted (green border/tint) but its button is the secondary white style, while only Free has the green primary button, so the highlighted plan and the primary action disagree.
expected: Highlighted plan carries the primary button, or no plan is highlighted.
actual: Free: green button; Developer (highlighted) and Team: white buttons.
suggested_fix: Align emphasis between card highlight and button style.

description: Clicking 'Manage your plan' ends on a Clerk-hosted page (dominant-aardvark-1062.accounts.dev) that is dark with a purple button and no Agent Drive logo, unlike the in-app light, branded /sign-in and /sign-up pages. The user leaves the agent-drive domain unexpectedly.
expected: Redirect to the app's own /sign-in (light, branded, same domain).
suggested_fix: Set Clerk signInUrl (NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_SIGN_IN_URL) so auth.protect() redirects to /sign-in on the app domain.
